info.title: tracktime API
info.description:
Read and write tracked time, the catalog behind it, and reports over both.

Authenticate with an API token as `Authorization: Bearer tt_…`. A token is bound to one workspace and carries the visibility its creating member had when it was minted, intersected with that member's visibility right now — it can never show more than its owner may see.

bearerAuth.description: An API token from Settings → API. Format: `tt_<prefix>_<secret>`.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail. `type` dereferences to documentation for the failure.
